organizationId.description: ID of the contact center organization. This field is required for all bulk save operations.

id.description: ID of this contact center resource. It should not be specified when creating a new resource. However, it is mandatory when updating a resource.

version.description: The version of this resource. For a newly created resource, it will be 0 unless specified otherwise.

name.description: A name for the Agent's personal greeting file. It should have valid extension i.e. .wav

contentType.description: Indicates Content-Type of the Audio file. It can take one of these values: AUDIO_WAV, AUDIO_X_WAV

agentId.description: Agent Id with which this greeting file is to be associated with.

attributeTag.description: This is used to identify the purpose of a greeting.

firstName.description: First Name of the Agent with whom this greeting file is to be associated with.

lastName.description: Last Name of the Agent with whom this greeting file is to be associated with.

email.description: Email of the Agent with whom this greeting file is to be associated with.

agentActive.description: Indicates whether the Agent with whom this greeting file is to be associated with is active or not active

ciUserId.description: Id of the Agent in common identity with whom this greeting file is to be associated with.

createdTime.description: This is the created time of the entity.

lastUpdatedTime.description: This is the updated time of the entity.
